title: feat(cli)!: os serve refuses a database local to each replica under declared multi-replica on redis
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97twPkYWDaEC1mVdzx5qXfr)_

Fixes #31928

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — measured on this head: a boot that declares several replicas (`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=2`, or `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) over `OS_CLUSTER_DRIVER=redis` with a SQLite `file:` database, the no-URL SQLite default or a sqlite-wasm file now exits 1 naming a Postgres `OS_DATABASE_URL`; on the ablated head (the throw disabled) the same boots go on, and the gate-admitted one prints `Server is ready` on SQLite. Nothing is widened: no route, key, flag, error code or package export is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no multi-replica deployment; the two `content/docs` pages this change made false or incomplete (`kernel/cluster.mdx`, `deployment/self-hosting.mdx`) are corrected here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：声明多副本（`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS>1` 或 `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`）且集群驱动是 redis 时，若主数据库是 SQLite（含不设 `OS_DATABASE_URL` 的默认文件）、sqlite-wasm 或 libSQL `file:`，`os serve` 启动即 exit 1，并提示改用 Postgres 的 `OS_DATABASE_URL`。
- 为什么改：每个副本各开一份本地库，数据在副本间静默分叉；这是多副本高可用（cloud#3814 N3）的前置拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只在上述声明下求值，单节点与其它集群驱动路径不变；远程 libSQL、Postgres、MySQL、MongoDB 不拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`（存储第 2 步之前的拒绝块，与文件末尾 `multiReplicaLocalDatabaseRefusal`）；`packages/cli/test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts`（新 describe 与三条被迫改动的用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts`，预期 7/7 通过，其中 `file:` 用例 exit 1 且输出含 `OS_DATABASE_URL=postgres://`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The refusal** (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`). Under `declaresReplicasSharingState(process.env)` (the CLI's existing pre-boot form of `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, shared with the `os start` auth-secret refusal), `serve` reads the primary database the boot already resolved and refuses a local one before step 2 registers anything:
  - standalone and artifact boots: `resolveStandaloneDatabase` over the same input `createStandaloneStack` / `createDefaultHostConfig` was given (new local `standaloneDatabaseInput`, set beside `standaloneSqlitePrimary`);
  - the legacy host-config boot: this command's own `OS_DATABASE_URL` fallback, `resolveDriverType` + `resolveStorageDefinition` (a selection those refuse is left to step 2, which refuses it as before);
  - a host config whose own plugin provides the driver resolves neither and is not judged (see Acceptance notes).
- **What counts as local**: `multiReplicaLocalDatabaseRefusal({ driver, url })`, pure and exported for its unit pin. `sqlite` and `sqlite-wasm` are local; `turso` is local only when its URL is itself a SQLite file, read by the existing `inferDriverTypeFromUrl` (no new URL parsing). The text names the variables and the Postgres remedy and never the URL.
- **Placement** (step 0, seat ruling 6740708364): after datasource resolution and before `runtime.start`, so ahead of the split-brain guard; not beside the multi-node gate, where the legacy route has no plugin list yet. No error code: the same shape as the `os start` auth-secret refusal (one stderr line, exit 1).
- **Docs**: `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` said SQLite works the same beside the redis driver, which this makes false; `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` gains the refusal beside "all replicas must share the same database".
- **Test helper**: `runServe` (`packages/cli/test/helpers/serve-process.ts`) now returns `exitCode`, the child's own code when it exited before `waitFor` matched, so the pin reads exit 1 rather than a missing banner.

## Tests

- New unit pin `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-multi-replica-local-database.test.ts` (26 cases), every case fed by the real resolutions: refused for a `file:` URL, a relative `file:./` URL, `:memory:`, the no-URL SQLite default, a bare path, two sqlite-wasm spellings and libSQL over `file:`, `file:./` and `:memory:` (standalone and fallback); not refused for `libsql://`, a Turso `https://` host, libSQL over `wss://` and `http://` server URLs, postgres, mysql and mongodb.
- New `describe` in the shared harness `packages/cli/test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts` (real `os serve` boots): `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:…` + redis + `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=2` → exit 1 naming `OS_DATABASE_URL=postgres://`, ahead of the guard; the SQLite default and sqlite-wasm the same; CONTROL: the same `file:` database with nothing declared boots. Budget header 40 → 58 (eight boots, 45.86 s local reading x 1.25).
- **Forced test changes** (same harness): three existing gate cases declared a topology over the fixture's SQLite default, which this PR now refuses first. All three now boot over an unreachable `mysql://` database with `OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE=true`.
  - Cases 1 and 3 (no gate, `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` / `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=2`): the refusal they read is still the split-brain guard's. Assertions unchanged.
  - Case 4 (a registered gate admits `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) keeps its gate assertions (asked about 2, no denial) and now also asserts neither the guard's refusal nor the local-database one. Its `booted === true` is **removed**: measured over the shared database, the boot passes the guard and then stops at the first plugin that reads data (the auth plugin's start, `No driver available for object 'sys_organization'`). A completed declared boot needs a database server every replica shares, which this suite does not run; the harness header says so.

## Acceptance notes

- **Known limitation (seat-ruled):** not judged — a host config whose own plugin registers the storage driver. Neither resolution can see that driver before boot, so such a deployment on SQLite under multi-replica is not refused here.
- libSQL embedded replicas (a `file:` URL with `syncUrl`) can only be declared in a datasource config, not through `OS_DATABASE_URL`; a `file:` libSQL primary is refused whatever its sync setting, because every replica would still write its own file.
- Base reading: the unit file cannot run on `main` (the function does not exist there); the integration RED is the wiring ablation below, which disables only the throw.

## Verification

Final head `e07ef903` (round 2: test, test-helper comment and docs changes only over `2f59522a`; `serve.ts` unchanged since `771e7284`), local card container.

<details><summary>Unit pin, integration harness, cli unit tier, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/serve-multi-replica-local-database.test.ts` (final head) → Test Files 1 passed, Tests 26 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` (final head) → Test Files 2 passed, Tests 18 passed. The gate-declaration file alone read 45.86 s of test time in round 1.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit` (packages/cli, `2bf77f56`) → Test Files 408 passed (408), Tests 5833 passed (5833); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` → VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint packages/cli --no-inline-config` (final head) → exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- Wiring: `if (refusal) throw new Error(refusal);` → `if (refusal && process.env.OS_ABLATION_NEVER) …`, cli rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 1 built file. Integration: 3 failed / 4 passed — the `file:` case, the default + wasm case and the admitted-gate case (which then printed `Server is ready` on SQLite), each `expected … to contain '[database] Refusing to start: several…'`. CONTROL stayed green. Restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` over 924 built files.
- Remote libSQL: `if (urlKind === 'sqlite' || urlKind === 'sqlite-wasm') return 'a libSQL file';` → `return 'a libSQL file';`. Unit (26 cases): 3 failed / 23 passed — `a libsql:// server URL (standalone)`, `a Turso https:// host (standalone)`, `a libsql:// server URL (fallback)`.
- Unclassified libSQL server URL: the `catch { return undefined; }` after `inferDriverTypeFromUrl` → `return 'a libSQL file';`. Unit: 4 failed / 22 passed — libSQL over `wss://` and `http://`, standalone and fallback.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates and dogfood</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `e07ef903` (and before it at `2f59522a`): 103 commands, each run and recorded as `CMD :: exit N`; all 103 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 103 derived, 103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- First sweep (at `2bf77f56`): `check:test-source-alias` exit 1 (the new unit pin reached the lazy `@objectstack/cloud-connection` import through `start.ts`) — fixed by the module-top import in `2f59522a`; `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 on the shallow clone's missing fixture commit, green after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…`.

- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, after a full `pnpm build`, head `2bf77f56`): Test Files 442 passed, 3 skipped (445); Tests 3669 passed, 42 skipped (3711); VERDICT command-exit 0. `e07ef903` differs from it only in cli test files, the test helper's comment and two docs pages, none of which a dogfood file reads; no source changed.

</details>
